name: Agent registration
description: The agent host as DNA: an agent proves work, registers into a sandbox organization with a credential and a claim link, authors documents, and is claimed by its person or expires. The registration's states are the organization record's, so the history of its Actions can be held equal to that record. From v2 the DNA admin can suspend a production organization and reinstate it, a person can revoke the agent's credential, and each organization's daily usage is recorded.

entities.name: Challenge
entities.description: A proof-of-work puzzle the host issues before registration. It is spent by one registration or expires.

attributes.name: difficulty
attributes.description: The leading zero bits a solution needs.

attributes.name: network
attributes.description: The source network it was issued to, which the per-network limit counts.

entities.name: Agent
entities.description: The registering client, named as the agent in its credential.

entities.name: Registration
entities.description: One organization's lifecycle on the host. sandbox, production and expired are the organization record's own: environment sandbox, environment production, and the expired tombstone.

attributes.name: organization
attributes.description: The tenant organization the registration created.

attributes.name: person
attributes.description: The person the agent acts for. Absent once expired.

attributes.name: expiresAt
attributes.description: When an unclaimed sandbox expires. Absent once claimed.

attributes.name: claimedBy
attributes.description: The claimant, as the identity port named them.

entities.name: Credential
entities.description: A credential is an entity because the connection between an agent and its registration carries scopes and an expiry. The token itself is a secret and never DNA.

attributes.name: scopes
attributes.description: Scope slugs from the host's access DNA.

entities.name: Claim
entities.description: The link a person follows to claim the sandbox. Its token is a secret and never DNA; its URL is returned once, at registration.

entities.name: Document
entities.description: A whole domain document the agent authors. Each change is its next immutable version.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: The organization the document belongs to, through its registration.

entities.name: Usage
entities.description: An organization's governed acts in one UTC day: what the sandbox cap and, later, the meter count.

relationships.name: creates
relationships.description: The tenant organization a registration created.

relationships.name: acts for
relationships.description: The person the agent acts for.

relationships.name: of
relationships.description: The agent the credential is issued to.

relationships.name: for
relationships.description: The registration the credential acts on.

relationships.name: of
relationships.description: The registration the claim link claims.

relationships.name: in
relationships.description: The organization the document belongs to.

relationships.name: authored by
relationships.description: The agent that wrote the document.

relationships.name: of
relationships.description: The organization the usage is counted for.
